signal: Dominion DMS expanded its cloud-native VUE DMS with new integrations (DealerPay) and a KADA partnership, and appointed Cliff Lavergne as President

email.subject1: a signal play for Dominion DMS
email.body1:
Arlene, saw Dominion DMS expanding VUE with new integrations like DealerPay and a fresh KADA partnership under new leadership.

Momentum like that usually opens more in-market dealer accounts than BD can actually touch, and that is where good-fit deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Dominion DMS off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Arlene, quick follow-up for Dominion DMS.

As VUE adds integrations and partnerships, the addressable dealer base grows faster than your selling capacity can. Most teams do not actually know how many meetings they need to book to cover it, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Dominion needs to cover franchised dealers this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Arlene, last bit of proof for Dominion DMS.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Dominion's reply rate likely compares to other automotive software firms. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Arlene, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling dealer pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. With new integrations and a leadership transition, there is plenty competing for your attention.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an automotive software BD motion? I will tailor it to Dominion either way.
